title: Saint Francis Quote
content: “If you work with your hands, you’re a laborer.If you work with your hands and your mind, you’re a craftsman.If you work with your hands and your mind and your heart, you’re an artist.”—Saint Francis of Assisi------------The self portrait (meant to symbolize "artist") is byBurton SilvermanFactcheck:The quote may not actually appear in the writings of St. Francis. It also appears in the writings of Louis Nizer.Thanks,Dennis!
